description: Shopee Product Research: shopee/get Product Infos API.

approvedDateEnd.description: The end value of the store opening time (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

approvedDateStart.description: The starting value of the store opening time (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

cidList.description: Category id list, complete path, multiple groups separated by `｜`, such as: `AAA,BBB,CCC｜DDD,EEE`.

estimateSoldEnd.description: Estimate the end value of the number of units sold in the first 30 days.

estimateSoldStart.description: Estimate the starting value of the number of units sold in the first 30 days.

favoriteMin.description: The starting value of the number of collections.

historicalSoldEnd.description: The end value of the total number of units sold of the product.

historicalSoldStart.description: The starting value of the total number of units sold of the product.

isHotSales.description: Whether it is a hot seller: 0 = not a hot seller, 1 = a hot seller.

lastModiTimeEnd.description: The latest crawl time end value (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

lastModiTimeStart.description: The latest crawl time starting value (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

listingDateFrom.description: The starting value of product shelf time (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

notExistKeywordType.description: Exclude match patterns: 1=whole sentence (default), 2=multi-word AND, 3=multi-word OR.

notExistShopIdList.description: Exclude a list of store IDs, separated by multiple commas.

orderBy.description: Sorting fields: `rating` (rating), `price` (price), `historical_sold` (total sales), `sold` (30-day sales), `payment` (30-day sales), `favorite` (number of collections), `ratings` (number of ratings), `gen_time` (time on shelves), `estimate_sold` (estimated sales).

paymentEnd.description: Ending value of sales amount in the previous 30 days.

paymentStart.description: The starting value of sales amount in the previous 30 days.

pids.description: List of product IDs (up to 500), separated by commas.

priceMax.description: The end value of the total price of the product.

priceMin.description: Total product price starting value (local currency).

ratingsMax.description: The end value of the score.

ratingsMin.description: The starting value of the score.

shopIdList.description: Specify a list of store IDs, separated by multiple commas.

skuNumberEnd.description: The end value of the total number of SKUs.

skuNumberStart.description: Starting value of the total number of SKUs.

soldMax.description: The end value of the number of units sold in the previous 30 days.

soldMin.description: The starting value of the number of units sold in the previous 30 days.

statTimeEnd.description: End value of statistical time (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

statTimeStart.description: Starting value of statistical time (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

station.description: **Required**. Shopee site, you can pass the name or code. See site mapping table below.
